Name: Vanilla Texture Frog Cursors
Author: SleepingCipher
Description:
[color=#38761d][size=4][b]Description[/b][/size][/color]
A frog cursor pack, that gives you a vanilla-style frog for a cursor.
It is my first mod, and it may be a bit hard to see the cursor due to it being so small... but hey! Frog!<3

[color=#38761d][size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size][/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]1. Install Smapi[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]2. Install Content Patcher[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]3. Install Frog Cursor[/color]

[color=#38761d][size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size][/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]Frog is small, but can be used to hover in places, looking as if there is a frog there. Some fun spots are; Villagers' heads, on top of roofs, bouncing across screen.[/color]

[color=#38761d][size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size][/color]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Smapi[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Content Patcher[/color][/size]
